fields.description: Issue features editorials and political commentary on Dade County and Miami Beach politics, including criticism of state representatives regarding a local-option pari-mutuel racing bill and a proposed Miami Beach county referendum. Includes coverage of public-utility concerns (notably Florida Power & Light), local transportation complaints, and civic “clean up” appeals ahead of a Lions convention. Regular columns and humor pieces appear alongside letters to the editor, society/community notes, and substantial advertising (including telephone service, transit, entertainment, and real estate/Coral Gables development).
